subject: Revert "Simplify offline build (#73)" (#93)
reason: The change is a revert that touches only the build system and CI: .github/workflows/ci.yml, CMakeLists.txt, src/CMakeLists.txt and build.sh. It removes the VALKEY_INCLUDE_DIR and RAPIDJSON_SOURCE_DIR offline-build paths and restores the unconditional ExternalProject fetch of Valkey, changing only how headers and dependencies are obtained during compilation.
